name: backend_architecture
description: Guides the implementation of the Laravel 12 Modular Monolith architecture using nwidart/laravel-modules, strictly enforcing thin controllers and a centralized Service layer for business logic.

name: frontend_architecture
description: Covers React 18, TypeScript 5, and Inertia.js 2 integration, ensuring server-driven state patterns and optimal Vite 7 build configuration with manual chunking.

name: ui_and_styling
description: Enforces the use of Shadcn UI (base-nova style) and Tailwind CSS v4, ensuring ARIA-compliant, accessible components and standard UI layout constraints.

name: animation_and_motion
description: Guides the purposeful use of GSAP and Framer Motion for smooth, performant micro-interactions, page transitions, and success states that do not exceed 300ms.

name: database_and_models
description: Dictates database schema isolation between modules, mandatory use of soft deletes, and implementation of Spatie model states and polymorphic relationships.

name: security_and_auth
description: Enforces strict route, middleware, and component-level authorization using spatie/laravel-permission, along with standard Auth scaffolding (Breeze, Sanctum).

name: realtime_events
description: Manages the integration of Laravel Reverb WebSockets for real-time notifications, UI updates, and synchronization with frontend state management (Zustand).
